feed.message: FLOW Lead started a new mission: Build FLOW COMMAND — Founder Mission Control.
Inspected agent definitions, orchestration rules, admin auth model, and existing UI components before designing the approach.
Created the status file this dashboard reads from, and documented when it gets updated.
Built the reusable checkpoint progress trail component used by the mission bar.
Handed the full dashboard page off to Admin Control Center.
Built the /admin/command page, its data layer, seven dashboard components, and a navigation link. Its own checks (typecheck, lint, build) passed.
Handed the finished page to QA Security for an independent review.
Reviewed the dashboard's security and correctness, tested how it handles a missing or broken status file, and ran the full build/lint/typecheck check. Verdict: PASS, nothing blocking.
FLOW COMMAND is built and QA'd. Waiting for the founder to review before anything is committed.
